description.value: Xin Chào is an authentic Northern Vietnamese restaurant situated in Vancouver's Cambie Village, serving family-recipe dishes including pho, bun bo hue, banh mi, and fresh salad rolls. As a blended-family business, the restaurant makes a point of welcoming diverse diners with halal-certified proteins across most of its menu, alongside gluten-free and vegetarian options. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with online ordering through the restaurant's own website.
